headline: Good to see you
body: Tell me what you're working on. I can read your code, run things, search, and carry a task through to done.

headline: What can I take off your plate?
body: A bug, a report, a messy folder, a half-finished idea. Hand it over and I'll show my work as I go.

headline: Robo, at your service
body: Point me at a file, paste an error, or just describe the goal. I'll ask only what I need to.

headline: Let's make some progress
body: Give me the task in your own words. I'll plan it, do it, check it, and tell you what changed.

headline: Where shall we begin?
body: Say it or type it. I can work in your terminal, your files and your browser while you do something else.

headline: Ready.
body: State the task.

headline: Go ahead.
body: Goal, file, or error. I'll handle the rest.

headline: Listening.
body: One line is plenty.

headline: What's the job?
body: I'll do it, verify it, report back. Briefly.

headline: Standing by.
body: Short in, short out. Ask for detail if you want it.

headline: Session up. Tools loaded.
body: Give me a path, a failing test or a trace. I'll reproduce first, then fix, then prove it with a run.

headline: Awaiting input
body: Accepts: repo paths, stack traces, diffs, specs. Returns: a plan, a patch, and the command output that backs it.

headline: Environment ready
body: Filesystem, shell, git, web and browser are attached. Name the target and the acceptance criteria.

headline: What are we debugging?
body: Paste the error verbatim. I'll bisect, isolate the cause, and give you the minimal change that fixes it.

headline: Specify the task
body: Inputs, constraints, definition of done. I'll keep the diff small and the reasoning visible.

headline: A spark is all it takes
body: Bring me the rough idea, the odd sketch, the thing that almost works. We'll find its shape together.

headline: What shall we make?
body: A tool, a story, a prototype, a better name for it. I'll draft boldly and you steer.

headline: Blank page, warm engine
body: Start anywhere. A sentence is enough; I'll offer three directions and build the one you like.

headline: Let's try something
body: Half an idea is welcome here. I'll mock it up fast so we can see whether it has legs.

headline: Show me the mess
body: Tangled notes, broken code, a vague hunch. Good work usually starts there.

headline: What would you like to learn?
body: Ask about any file, idea or error. I'll explain why it works, not only what to type.

headline: Let's work through it
body: Show me where you're stuck. We'll take it one step at a time, and you'll keep the understanding.

headline: No question is too small
body: If something's unclear, that's on the explanation, not on you. Ask, and I'll try another way.

headline: Ready for today's lesson
body: Pick a topic or paste some code. I'll give the short answer first, then the reasoning behind it.

headline: Curious about something?
body: I'll explain it, show it running, then hand you a small exercise if you want to make it stick.
